info.title: BAC Testing API - IDOR & Privilege Escalation Lab
info.description:
Backend API untuk testing IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) vulnerability:
- **Horizontal IDOR**: Access control bypass antar user dengan role sama
- **Vertical Escalation**: Privilege escalation dari employee ke admin

**Authentication:**
- Menggunakan JWT (JSON Web Token)
- Access Token: Valid 24 jam
- Refresh Token: Valid 7 hari
- Format: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`

**Test Users:**
- Admin: `admin` / `admin123` (ID: 1)
- Employee1: `employee1` / `employee123` (ID: 2) - Attacker
- Employee2: `employee2` / `employee123` (ID: 3) - Victim

BearerAuth.description:
JWT Access Token didapat dari endpoint `/api/auth/login`.
Format header: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`
Token expires dalam 24 jam. Gunakan refresh token untuk mendapatkan access token baru.
